cases.input: Research a named diagnostics executive using current employer biographies, company announcements, patents, publications and reputable professional sources, then build a reusable professional evidence profile.
requiredBehaviors: disambiguate the person before merging sources
build a professional timeline with claim and source provenance
separate direct facts, self-reported professional claims and derived capabilities
derive capabilities only from referenced claims
record research date and evidence currency
forbiddenBehaviors: turn the profile into a role-fit score
infer personality traits from titles, prestige or media presence
skillAnchors: What professional evidence exists about this person?
Jede Capability muss auf ihre Claims zurückverfolgbar bleiben

cases.input: Only a current company bio, an old speaker profile and a self-reported LinkedIn claim are available, while two sources disagree about the start year of a prior role.
requiredBehaviors: produce a partial profile rather than fill missing career history
mark the LinkedIn claim as self-reported professional evidence
keep the conflicting start dates visible
lower confidence where evidence is sparse or contradictory

cases.input: A draft profile attributes all company growth to the executive, treats missing P&L evidence as proof of no P&L experience, and includes private health and family information found online.
requiredBehaviors: reject unsupported individual attribution of company outcomes
replace absence claims with not-found language unless explicit evidence exists
remove irrelevant sensitive and private information from the professional profile
forbiddenBehaviors: persist sensitive personal information because it is public
state unsupported causal achievement claims as fact
skillAnchors: Nicht gefundene Information wird als not-found dokumentiert
Nicht zu recherchierende oder zu persistierende Bereiche
